text:
Alicia: FYI escalation from ACME Corp — they say our invoice PDFs are failing PO validation and missing legal entity fields. They want: legal name, registered office address, tax/VAT ID, line-item breakdown per model call, and a visible PO number field on the PDF.

Emma: they just opened a ticket with a sample PO attached. PO requires 'Supplier Legal Entity' and a separate 'Billing Address' block. Also VAT reverse charge flag for EU customers.

Zara: Confirming from customer side — we need each usage line to show: model name, request timestamp, tokens billed, unit price, subtotal. One PDF per month, with a single total at the end and VAT line(s) broken out. PO number must appear in header and as an invoice metadata field so their AP system can match automatically.

Raj: Thanks — are we talking about hosted billing PDFs only or Dedicated/Private too? Need repro steps. I can trigger a sample invoice from staging if someone gives the exact payload they expect.

Alicia: Hosted only for now (this customer uses hosted). Emma attached the PO example to the ticket (I uploaded to the thread). They provided legal entity: "ACME Europe Ltd." with VAT GB999999999 and registered office "1 Acme Plaza, London, UK, EC1 1AA".

Oliver: Legal wants the PDF to show both "Supplier Legal Entity" and a separate "Registered Office" field — not combined. Also include our company registration number if possible.

Maya: Payment side — separate issue: this customer had a card decline while the invoice was being generated (succeeded on retry). Decline code: `do_not_honor`. If we change invoice layout, ensure our webhook `invoice.payment_failed` includes `invoice_reference` and PO number so customers can reconcile.

Dave: I can modify the PDF renderer but need the desired JSON invoice schema. Proposal below — please review and flag missing fields: ```json
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_20250301_0001",
  "issued_at": "2025-03-01T08:00:00Z",
  "due_at": "2025-03-31T23:59:59Z",
  "po_number": "PO-8742",
  "supplier": {
    "legal_name": "Redwood Inference, Inc.",
    "registered_office": "123 Redwood Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94301, USA",
    "company_number": "C1234567",
    "tax_id": "US-EIN-12-3456789"
  },
  "billing_address": "ACME Europe Ltd., 1 Acme Plaza, London, EC1 1AA, UK",
  "line_items": [
    { "description": "gpt-large generate - model_id: gpt-large, 10k tokens", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": "0.050", "amount": "500.00", "meta": {"model":"gpt-large","tokens":10000} },
    { "description": "embedding - model_id: embed-small, 1k tokens", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": "0.010", "amount": "10.00", "meta": {"model":"embed-small","tokens":1000} }
  ],
  "taxes": [ {"label":"VAT 20%","rate":"0.20","amount":"102.00"} ],
  "subtotal": "510.00",
  "total": "612.00"
}
```

Emma: That schema looks good. Two asks: (1) Make `line_items[].description` include a concise machine-parsable tag like `model:gpt-large` so their AP system can map GL codes. (2) Add `billing_contact` and `billing_email` fields visible on PDF.

Dave: Noted. I'll expose `line_items[].meta.model` as `tags` in the PDF and add `billing_contact` in the template.

Raj: For repro, I'll create a staging customer with the PO and VAT fields and request an invoice. Dave — can you wire the staging PDF generator to include your new fields so I can attach the output to the support ticket?

Dave: Yes — ETA end of day tomorrow. Template variables we'll support: `{{supplier.legal_name}}`, `{{supplier.registered_office}}`, `{{supplier.company_number}}`, `{{supplier.tax_id}}`, `{{billing_address}}`, `{{po_number}}`, `{{billing_contact}}`, `{{line_items}}`, `{{taxes}}`.

BillingBot: invoice.generated inv_20250301_0001 for acct_acme_eu — status: pending_payment — webhook sent to https://hooks.acme-payments.example — event: invoice.created

Maya: On the tax front — EU customers sometimes require a VAT reverse charge notation. We should add an optional `tax_notes` section on the PDF where we can render legal text like: "VAT reverse charge applies per Article 194 of the VAT Directive." Also include `vat_number` for both supplier and customer near the top.

Oliver: Confirmed. Also verify localization for addresses — UK addresses should be formatted differently than US. PDF generator should accept `address_format` or infer from country code.

Zara: One more from customer — line items must be sortable by date or by model in CSV export; PDF can be grouped by model. They want CSV importable to their ERP.

Emma: Action items: 1) Dave to update invoice JSON + PDF template to include supplier registered fields, company number, PO placement, `billing_contact`, `tags` on line items, `tax_notes`, and `address_format` support. 2) Raj to repro on staging and attach PDF to the ticket. 3) Maya to ensure webhooks include `invoice_reference`, `po_number`, and decline codes when payment fails. 4) Oliver to approve final legal wording for `tax_notes`.

Alicia: Priority P1 for this customer — please loop me in when staging PDF ready. Emma, add the customer's SLA breach risk to the ticket if not delivered in 48 hrs.

Dave: I'll post a link to the staging PDF here when ready.

Raj: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with the support ticket ID and logs (I'll include `payment_attempts` array and `decline_codes`). :thumbsup:

Oliver: I'll draft `tax_notes` language and post quick approval later today.

BillingBot: webhook.retry for invoice.inv_20250301_0001 — attempt 2 of 3 — status: delivered

Maya: If card declines persist, we should offer a one-click update link in the `invoice.payment_failed` email that pre-fills `invoice_reference` and `po_number` on the retry flow. Saves customer's AP team a manual step.

Zara: Appreciate the responsiveness. Please ensure the PDF filename includes `invoice_id` and `po_number` (e.g., `INV_inv_20250301_0001_PO-8742.pdf`) so our ingestion picks it up automatically.

Alicia: Noted. We'll aim to satisfy both the content and naming conventions.

Dave: Update: staging PDF generator updated and pushed to staging branch `billing/pdf-po-fields` — link: https://staging.redwood.internal/billing/pdf/preview/inv_20250301_0001 (will expire in 72h).

Raj: I pulled the preview and uploaded to the support ticket. Customer confirmed header fields and PO visible. Still needs VAT reverse charge text added.

Oliver: I'll drop the final VAT reverse charge text by EOD.

Alicia: Great work team. Keep the thread updated with any blocking issues.
